description: A Java class LogView extending TextView that implements LogNode interface to display log messages in a UI component, formatting log data and handling log chaining.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for displaying log messages received via LogNode interface, supporting log formatting and chaining.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, converting priority to string, appending exception info if present, and updating UI thread.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the log display.
